season.evidence: Logged ascents 188 in Oct, 51 Sep, 40 Aug. Searches (guides, WTA, SummitPost): snow-free by July, Jul-Oct season, larches peak around Oct 1-15, snow in the basin by early Nov; trailhead snowed in by Nov/Dec. Stored Jul-Oct kept.

track.why: Only route on the peak; summited 5 Oct 2023 on a round trip from the Phelps Creek trailhead: starts 137 m from our pin, ends 115 m, high point within 11 m of Peakbagger summit (70 m of ours), follows the Carne Mountain trail line.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 8 Oct 2023, passes 4 m from the summit but starts 181 m and ends 358 m from the pin
Oct 2024 loop goes to a 2525 m high point 5 km away, bagging Carne on the way out

facts.text: In early June the creek crossings near the trailhead can run deep with melt, and snow is continuous above about 5,000 ft in the upper basin.
The road up to Phelps Creek may be newly opened in early June, with several downed trees across its last stretch.

notes: Peakbagger summit is 79 m from our pin (within 100 m, not clearly off) so no move proposed.
